title: 5.37 Acres in Texas Hill Country – Lampasas River Access
description:
Just an hour northwest of Austin, this 5.37-acre parcel offers a rare opportunity to own land inside a 1,000+ acre, high-fenced wildlife preserve teeming with over 300 exotic animals—including bighorn sheep, axis deer, and more. Located just outside Kempner, TX, the property features towering oaks, sweeping Hill Country vistas, and a level homesite that gently slopes toward the hills and nearby river.
Set within a gated community with sensible covenants to maintain value, the entire preserve is secured with high fencing and code-controlled entry. As an owner, you’ll have exclusive access to the Lampasas River greenbelt and a scenic community park right along the riverbank—ideal for fishing, hiking, picnicking, or simply unwinding in nature.

This particular lot (Lot #158) is perfectly positioned next to a tranquil fishing pond and offers some of the best views in the community—making it an ideal site for your dream home. With an AG/Wildlife Exemption already in place, the property benefits from remarkably low taxes.

Private showings are available by appointment—come experience the beauty and privacy for yourself.
